description: This file defines a React client component for the notes feature, managing note creation and navigation within a Next.js application. It includes UI interactions such as button click handlers and state management, and references external components and APIs.

methods.name: getDefaultTitle
methods.description: Generates a default title string based on the current date and time, formatted as 'Day - YYYY-MM-DD - HH:MM'.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Asynchronous handler function that sets creation state, calls the API to create a new note with a default title and optional tag, then navigates to the new note's page.
